subject: MG CFA error message: problems with unequal sample sizes?

messages.author: 93e4891e64af5f62
messages.subject: MG CFA error message: problems with unequal sample sizes?
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am trying to run a multi-group CFA with blavaan for the first time. The CFA works well but when I add the "group=x" in the command, I always get the error message [1] "Error in dat$Obsvar[i, (dat$Nobs[i] + 1):nvar] <- allvars[!(allvars %in%  : \n  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length\n". The sample sizes of my groups vary from N=77 to N=111. When I only use N=77 for every group, the model works fine again. Is there a problem with using unequal sample sizes in MG CFA in blavaan or am I missing something obvious?

Here is my code:

ObedM1<-'Obed=~Soz8_OB+Soz9_OB+Soz10_OB+Soz11_OB
Soz8_OB ~~ Soz10_OB'

testMG<-bcfa(ObedM1,data=dataobed,group = "country", burnin = 1000, sample = 1000

Thank you so much in advance!

Ronja

parts:
Ronja,

Sorry for the delay. I had a look at this and was able to run some simple models with many groups and unequal sample sizes. I am thinking that there might be some missing data issue that is specific to your dataset. I wonder whether your model works in lavaan, something like:

cfa(ObedM1, data=dataobed, group="country")

If not, perhaps the lavaan error message provides a clue.

If so, would it be possible for you to send me your dataset? (off list if needed)

Thanks,
Ed

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: MG CFA error message: problems with unequal sample sizes?
parts:
Thanks, this was a small bug that only appears when there is complete data in one group and missing data in another group. It should now be fixed on github, which you can install via

remotes::install_github("ecmerkle/blavaan", INSTALL_opts = "--no-multiarch")

Thanks for the report,
Ed
